delivery: native separate GPL QEMU executable; parent owns machine/build integration
verification_status: implemented-unverified; no build, test, formatter or linter run by PCNT worker

qom.access: aligned 32-bit little-endian; reserved holes return zero; count/status/RAW/ST read-only; CLR write-only
clock_inputs: apb-clk, connected before realize, no local guessed frequency
qom.gate: ESP32S3_GATE_PCNT, SYSTEM_PERIP_CLK_EN0[10]; initial device gate false until owner publishes level
qom.reset: ESP32S3_RST_PCNT, SYSTEM_PERIP_RST_EN0[10]; asserted reset-held resets register/filter state and ignores writes
qom.irq: one sysbus IRQ; parent connects ETS_PCNT_INTR_SOURCE

features.units_channels: 4 units, 2 channels each, target signals 33..48: pulse0,pulse1,control0,control1 per unit
features.inputs: electrical subscriber solved frames; GPIO matrix_sample applies routing/constants/inversion; public get_drive_snapshot.ie and net_valid reject disabled/unresolved inputs; UNKNOWN consumption triggers existing GPIO strict gate, never counts persisted sample
features.baseline: first resolved input sample establishes level without synthetic edge; inactive/reset/paused/gated channels do not consume inputs; unknown/disabled/bypassed input cancels candidates and needs new baseline
features.actions: positive/negative 1 increment, 2 decrement, 0/3 disabled; control 0 keep, 1 invert, 2/3 hold; both channels sum into one signed16 adder per accepted frame
features.glitch_filter: all four pulse/control inputs per unit; enabled threshold 0..1023 APB cycles; shorter transitions discarded; controls committed before pulses at identical completion time
features.filter_resources: 16 fixed candidate records, one bounded QEMUTimer, no per-edge allocation/copy, no zero-time timer loops
features.clock_phase: Q32 APB-cycle age and remainder retained across nonzero APB rate updates; previous period advances pending work before new period; gate/unknown invalidates input baseline rather than replaying edges
features.counter: signed16 modular arithmetic; directional high/low-limit equality clears count regardless of IRQ comparator enables; no count injection API or output drive authority
features.comparators: two signed16 thresholds and high/low limits applied after counter clear, including register changes while reset bit held; software readback remains written configuration
features.watchpoints: threshold1,threshold0,low-limit,high-limit,zero status bits2..6; individual CONF0 enables; per-unit RAW bits0..3, ENA masking, W1C; zero-mode bits0..1 retained independently
features.stop_reset: CTRL pause freezes adder, unit reset holds count zero; whole reset CTRL=0x55, CONF0=0x3c10, DATE=0x19072601, remaining registers zero; CPU-only domain resets preserve PCNT when soc-reset linked
features.register_clock: CTRL.CLK_EN bit16 stored/readable, not a counting gate; externally owned SYSTEM clock-enable is the operational gate

source_ambiguities.evidence: TRM1.8 p1449 and target generated headers describe register accessibility; reset is zero. Pinned IDF6.1 PCNT LL/driver never sets this bit yet programs all registers after SYSTEM gate enable.
source_ambiguities.model_policy: Do not block IDF register access based on CTRL.CLK_EN; retain the bit and use centralized SYSTEM gate. This policy is not claimed silicon-verified.
Enabled event bits accumulate until unit W1C; zero mode remains independently available. Silicon collision/metrology behavior is not qualified.

tests.stimulus: ProjectDocument v3 finite 3.3V powered MCU, GPIO4 wired to GPIO5 and GPIO6 wired to GPIO7. GPIO pad edges traverse solver then selected PCNT inputs. QMP snapshot-json confirms actual resolved voltage/validity on connected pulse/control nets.
tests.integration_fixture: Parent fixture worker owns tests/firmware/pulse_native; LEDC GPIO4-to-PCNT GPIO5 timing/control exercise is external to this worker's qtest and requires integrated verification.

Add esp32s3-pcnt-test to Xtensa qtest meson list; build native target once after all peer files land.
Run QTEST_QEMU_BINARY=<integrated qemu-system-xtensa> <build>/tests/qtest/esp32s3-pcnt-test with the native pc-bios directory; retain all four case results and binary hash.
Build/run the fixture-worker IDF6.1 pulse_native image on that exact native executable and v3 LEDC4-to-PCNT5 graph; require real LEDC edges, controls, negative/disconnect/stop/reset/gate results.
Do not mark SOC02 qualified until the integrated qtest and firmware evidence are recorded; independently review register-clock ambiguity and same-time event-latch policy.
